mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM team_member WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT user_id FROM team_member WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND leader_flag = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY user_id
SELECT tm.user_id FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} AND tm.deleted = 0 ORDER BY tm.user_id

SELECT DISTINCT u.department_id FROM team_member tm INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = tm.user_id WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} AND tm.deleted = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.department_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY u.department_id
